# Trinkner Dental Office

> Premier cosmetic and restorative dental practice in Columbia, SC led by Dr. Tom Trinkner, offering comprehensive smile enhancement and oral health services.

Dr. Tom Trinkner's dental office in Columbia, South Carolina specializes in cosmetic dentistry, restorative treatments, and general preventive care. The practice is known for advanced treatments like Invisalign, porcelain veneers, dental implants, and TMJ therapy, serving families and individuals throughout the Midlands region.
